review: Independent read-only review followed by root inspection of exact preserved vendor source.

findings.finding: AsicSetBmcQCR BMC_FLUSH ignores apidx, writes caller mask to ARB_BMCQCR1 and polls whole register for zero up to100 reads. apidx=2 is not per-BSS selection.
Existing USE_BMC flush supplies global mask0x7fff0001; copying this call cannot prove ra2-only retirement.
MBSS disable clears per-BSS TBTT/PRE_TBTT and beacon queue start bit; no BMC flush or data/late-TxS completion is established by this block.
MtAsicACQueue accepts BssidIdx/AC map and writes STOP/FLUSH/START masks, but returns VOID with no terminal completion poll or status-delivery join. This is not full ra2 drain proof.

missing_contract: Verified per-ra2 BMC/data queue addressing and completion semantics for MT7603E E1/E2.
Proof no new producer can enqueue across stop, and all in-flight DMA/FIFO/RF/TxS are retired.
Proof any scoped operation preserves Main/Guest and does not reset or scan physical radio.
decision: Do not bind RC QUIESCE to AsicSetBmcQCR(apidx=2), admin DOWN, or reference-only CLOSE. No safe driver-level fix proven by these interfaces.
scratch_cleanup: Exact archive read in memory; no extracted source or build output.
